title: am-ELO: A Stable Framework for Arena-based LLM Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Modeling human annotator discriminative ability and identifying anomalous or noisy annotators using a modified Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE) ELO framework (am-ELO) on pairwise preference data, validated through simulated adversarial annotator perturbations (randomizing, flipping, or forcing ties in votes).

Evaluating and mitigating the sensitivity of traditional ELO rating systems to the sequential order of battle data by replacing the iterative update method with an order-agnostic Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE) approach.
